newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nedlloyd sees 200 mln dfl container charge.
newsitem.headline: Nedlloyd sees 200 mln dfl container charge.

text.p: Koninklijke Nedlloyd Groep NV said on Monday it would take a 200 million guilder extraordinary charge in its results for the full year 1996, arising from its earlier announced container shipping merger.
Nedlloyd said earlier it would merge its container business with that of Britain's The Penninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Company Plc (P&O).

Nedlloyd's first half extraordinary gain resulted from the sale of a subsidiary and a refund from its pension fund which boosted total first half net profit to 276 million guilders from 96 million in the first half of 1995.

"The recovery of results in the ocean shipping sector strenghtens the executive board in its confidence that we will not make a loss for the wyhole of 1996," the company said in a statement with first half results.
